examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The Blog band with its four newest posts: the first is featured over a four-across wall of titles. Click a title, or move along the wall with the arrow, Home and End keys, to swap the featured article. WebKit ships no editorial media, so the covers here are the neutral `@aziontech/webkit/assets/placeholder-image.svg`; pass your own image URLs.

examples.name: Selected
examples.summary: `v-model` (the selected index) opens the band on its second article; a click or an arrow key writes the new index back.

site.name: Featured
site.summary: The Blog page's band: its four newest posts, the first featured over the wall of titles. WebKit ships no editorial media, so the covers here are the neutral `@aziontech/webkit/assets/placeholder-image.svg`; pass your own image URLs.
